abstract: Forty-eight selected patients with GCT who were suspected of having residual disease after two or three chemotherapy inductions underwent an attempt at resection of this residual tumor. In 37 patients all gross disease was resected: 11 had malignant tissue, eight adult teratoma, and 18 no residual neoplasm, and 9, 7 and 17, respectively, remain free of disease. Patients in whom complete resection was not possible generally did poorly. Elevated serum tumor markers following the completion of preoperative chemotherapy indicated residual malignant disease and poor probability for complete resection. Twenty-nine percent of patients with negative preoperative markers had malignancy at the time of surgery, but disease was resectable in most of these patients. The key for success is, first, the response to chemotherapy and, second, complete resection of residual disease. It is recommended that patients with initially bulky metastases (diameter greater than 5 cm) be first managed by chemotherapy, employing successive close inductions, and subsequently explored with intent to resect residual disease. When the resected specimen shows malignant elements, the patients should receive additional inductions, otherwise, maintenance chemotherapy is employed.
abstract_ja: 2～3回の化学療法導入後に残存病変が疑われた進行胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）患者48例を選択し、残存腫瘍の切除を試みました。37例で肉眼的病変をすべて切除しました。このうち11例に悪性組織、8例に成熟奇形腫、18例に残存腫瘍はありませんでした。完全切除が不可能だった患者は概して予後不良でした。化学療法終了後に腫瘍マーカーが上昇していた場合は残存悪性腫瘍が示唆され、完全切除の可能性は低いと考えられました。術前の腫瘍マーカーが陰性だった患者の29%に切除時の悪性腫瘍がありましたが、ほとんどの患者で病変は切除可能でした。成功の鍵は、第一に化学療法への反応、第二に残存病変の完全切除です。初診時に径5cmを超える大きな転移を有する患者は、まず連続的な密な導入化学療法で管理し、その後に残存病変の切除を目的として開腹探索を行うことが推奨されます。切除標本に悪性成分が認められた場合は追加の導入化学療法を行い、そうでなければ維持化学療法を行います。
